topic: Airframe-on-ground contact: sliding friction of film/wood/nylon on grass and paving, turf restitution and stiffness, ploughing of a dug-in edge
note: Guide: docs/research/ground-physics/GP-07/README.md. Local copies in the gitignored references/ground-contact-friction/ (reference only, do not redistribute). No source measures film, painted wood or nylon on natural grass: every friction value is a proxy. Dead ends: grass-ski or grass-sled friction, plastic or wood on grass incline tests, skin on natural turf, golf club-turf forces, UAV belly-slide distances, RC ground-loop or cartwheel thresholds; the casex UAV table (glass fibre on grass 0.15) is an unsupported guess.

files.use: Linthorne & Cooper 2013, Sports Biomechanics 12(2):175, Table I: smooth steel tubes towed over a natural-grass rugby pitch (short grass, hard ground), 0.5 m/s, 32-540 N: mu_k 0.45 +/- 0.01; authors suspect about 0.6 effective on uneven grass. 3G turf 0.35, AstroTurf 0.21, track 0.58. Anchor for runway 0.40 and mown 0.45.

files.use: Tables 3-5: lightly loaded rubber dragged on grass 0.68-0.80 dry, 0.59-0.74 wet; locked car wheels 0.21-0.38 dry, 0.17-0.24 wet. Light loads grip more; wet/dry ratio 0.58-0.92.
Sefic 1979, Table 3: 4130 steel skid on a dry lakebed at 9-22 m/s, flat 0.36-0.37; 6.4 mm keel 0.41-0.50; 12.7 mm keel 0.52-0.55 (dig-in adds about +0.10 to +0.17).

Field turf, 20 mm pin through the rootzone: 50 mm deep 300-480 N, 100 mm deep 520-860 N (0.26-0.48 MPa projected). Basis of the ploughing range q_s 0.1-0.5 MPa; wet clay shear strength 204 to 64 kPa from 14.8 to 20 % water.
